//: These settings are easier to change in-game! Mod List -> Breeze Spawn -> Config

Enable Breeze Spawn.//: Whether Breeze Spawn is enabled. When disabled, none of its features run and its other settings are hidden. Takes effect after a restart.

chanceBlazeIsBreeze.//: The chance a blaze that has spawned is a breeze entity. min: 0, max: 1

dimensionsToSpawnIn.//: Dimensions in which blazes can turn into breezes, separated by a comma. Leave empty for every dimension. For example: 'minecraft:the_nether'.

biomesToSpawnIn.//: Biomes in which blazes can turn into breezes, separated by a comma. Biome tags work too, starting with a '#'. Leave empty for every biome. For example: 'minecraft:nether_wastes,minecraft:soul_sand_valley'.
